title: Block season-plus-special tokens from rename TV titles
summary: Update rename title cleanup so TV source folder metadata such as S03+SP is stripped from detected show titles.
reason: A source folder named Ascendance of a Bookworm S03+SP 1080p Dual Audio BD Remux FLAC-TTGA currently allows release metadata to leak into the show title; the desired title is Ascendance of a Bookworm.
behavior_before: TV folder title cleanup could preserve Sxx+SP season/special tokens as part of the detected show title.
behavior_after: TV folder title cleanup strips Sxx+SP release metadata so the show title remains the canonical series name.
manual_validation: 2026-06-18: Bundled Python unittest passed: python -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_service_rename_tv tests.python.desktop.test_service_rename_tv_folder (11 tests).
2026-06-18: Exact sample cleaned to Ascendance of a Bookworm and auto-renamed to Ascendance of a Bookworm - S03E01 - The Beginning of Winter.mkv.
2026-06-18: refresh_summaries ran for edited source/test files and targeted packet summary.
rollback_plan: Revert the rename title cleanup and focused rename tests touched by this change, then remove this packet and its generated summary.
notes: No media policy, FFmpeg command generation, subtitle behavior, audio behavior, publish/drain flow, source/scratch/output movement, Local API mutation semantics, WebView controls, Tauri lifecycle behavior, or release scripts are intentionally changed.
